agentGuide: Base path /api/v1. Artists: GET /api/v1/artist; albums: GET /api/v1/album?artistId=<id>; tracks: GET /api/v1/track?albumId=<id>; missing: GET /api/v1/wanted/missing?pageSize=20. Find an artist: GET /api/v1/artist/lookup?term=<name>; add: POST /api/v1/artist with the lookup object plus qualityProfileId, metadataProfileId, rootFolderPath, monitored: true. Commands: ArtistSearch (artistId), AlbumSearch (albumIds), RefreshArtist, RssSync. Queue: GET /api/v1/queue; history: GET /api/v1/history?pageSize=20; calendar: GET /api/v1/calendar?start=YYYY-MM-DD&end=YYYY-MM-DD; health and version: GET /api/v1/health, /api/v1/system/status. Profiles and folders before adding: GET /api/v1/qualityprofile, /api/v1/rootfolder. Searches and refreshes are commands: POST /api/v1/command {"name": "..."}. Never send the key, it is set automatically.
